name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
summary: Run a 1M-context multimodal model for pennies — $0.30 per million input tokens at peak, half that off-peak. It beats the older V4 Pro on speed and cost, and the 485B weights are up on Hugging Face.

name: Suno v6
summary: Edit specific sections of a generated song by prompt, use images or video as creative references, and pull instruments out of samples. v6-mini is free for everyone; v6 and v6-wild need a paid plan.

name: ChatGPT Images 2.5
summary: Generate and edit images with much better likeness for people and pets, up to 50% faster. Rolling out to every ChatGPT tier plus Codex, with a @Sketch tool for drawing references and two new API models, Flare and Sunburst.

name: Desert Ant Labs
summary: Ship transcription, audio cleanup, PII redaction, and language ID that run entirely on-device, via Swift, Kotlin, or JavaScript SDKs. 18 models, no token billing, free up to 100,000 monthly active devices.

name: K2 Horizon
summary: Run a capable open model locally at 0.9B, 3.7B, or 7B, or self-host up to 375B. Apache 2.0 with weights, training data, and code published, plus day-zero Ollama, vLLM, and GGUF support.

name: Hermes Desktop
summary: Set up a local model in one click — the app reads your RAM, VRAM, and GPU, picks a model that fits, and starts a llama.cpp server. MIT-licensed and free on Mac, Windows, and Linux.

name: Gemini 3.8 Flash
summary: Point a coding agent at a much better workhorse for the same $0.75 per million input tokens as 3.7 Flash. Terminal-Bench jumps from 81.6% to 90.8%. Available now in AI Studio and the Gemini API.

name: Claude Fable 5.1
summary: Point a coding agent at harder, longer-running work, with better root-cause debugging and research. Typical workloads cost about 25% less than before, up to 45% for agentic tasks, and cache reads drop to $0.25 per million tokens.
